summary: {person} brings the executive a list of lawmakers needed to govern after the campaign is over.
realLife: Schlesinger recalled urging Bert Lance to build support among influential legislators, including energy committee chair Henry Jackson.
gates: A new executive needs legislative support for a priority.
weights: Campaign supporters hold few relevant committee seats.
inGame: needs: committee membership and the status of legislative commitments.

turns.what: A campaign ally already chairs the committee.
turns.pulledBy: The election coalition includes its chair.
turns.writesBack: The meeting is arranged through that ally.

turns.what: The chair offers a hearing alone.
turns.pulledBy: The chair has not committed to the bill.
turns.writesBack: The calendar records the hearing and leaves the vote open.
